source_target: Ag + Ti3SiC2 composite, existing normalized Gaussian/depth-exponential source
solidification_criterion: liquid Ag volume <= 1e-8 nm^3 for two consecutive steps
start_mode: cold start; not a checkpoint resume
heat_off_policy: Keep the configured 8.931899 mW source at full power; stop after an actual computed Ti3SiC2 maximum reaches 2100 K, or if the full configured source and bottom sink differ by <=0.01 mW for 10 consecutive steps. Hard property ceiling remains 2300 K.
source_policy: fixed full normalized Gaussian/depth-exponential source; no predictive source scaling
